parameters.command: ={{ $json.screenshotPaths.map(p => `node -e "const { chromium } = require('playwright'); (async () => { const browser = await chromium.launch(); const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1080, height: 1080 } }); await page.setContent(${JSON.stringify(p.html)}); await page.screenshot({ path: '${p.outputPath}', type: 'png' }); await browser.close(); })()"`).join(' && ') }}
